mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) indicates an economic slowdown coupled with monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong employment growth (PAYEMS increase > 0.5% MoM) signals sustained economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS increases by > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing market (HOUST > 1700) reflects strong consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1700.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) falls below 0.5% annualized, it indicates economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession expansion regimes, strong retail sales (RSAFS > 620,000) indicate robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 620,000 in post-recession expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) and decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1700) signals economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% and HOUST < 1700.
